summary.text: Robbie Martin, listed by Ballotpedia as Carl Martin (also known as Robbie), is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 65, where he has served since 2018, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Robbie Martin was born in Buckhannon, West Virginia, and earned a B.S. in business management from West Virginia Wesleyan College in 2014.
His career experience includes owning a business.
Martin has served in the House of Delegates since 2018 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
